## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results and anything not tested. Distinguish local mock/PC checks from console results. For UI changes, include 1080p/4K captures and controller/focus checks where applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped; unrelated source changes are not included.
- [ ] Existing credits and licenses are preserved; new dependencies have source, version and license notes.
- [ ] No personal logs, credentials, proprietary SDK files or unapproved binaries are included.
- [ ] Documentation and affected translations are updated or their remaining gaps are explicit.
- [ ] Sensitive reports follow SECURITY.md rather than this public pull request.
